gentle.title: A short walk after dinner
gentle.detail: Just ten gentle minutes after your evening meal. It can feel restful.

coach.title: Walk 10 minutes after dinner
coach.detail: A short walk after your largest meal helps glucose response. Keep it easy.

firm_direct.title: 10 minutes. After dinner. Walk.
firm_direct.detail: After tonight's biggest meal, walk ten minutes. That's the rep.

gentle.title: Take the stairs once today
gentle.detail: If stairs come up, choose them once. Small choices matter.

coach.title: One stairs-instead-of-elevator today
coach.detail: Pick one elevator moment and take the stairs. Counts as exercise.

firm_direct.title: Stairs. Once. Today.
firm_direct.detail: Skip one elevator. Take the stairs. Done.

gentle.title: A glass of water with a meal
gentle.detail: Pour a glass of water before you eat one meal today. Slow sips.

coach.title: Water alongside one meal today
coach.detail: Pair one meal with a full glass of water. Helps satiety, helps hydration.

firm_direct.title: Water with one meal. Today.
firm_direct.detail: Glass of water. One meal. No soda swap-in.

gentle.title: Add a protein source to one meal
gentle.detail: Eggs, beans, fish, tofu — pick one and add it to a meal today.

coach.title: One protein-anchored meal today
coach.detail: Add 20–30g of protein to one meal. Anything that walked, swam, or grew in a pod works.

firm_direct.title: Protein in one meal. Today.
firm_direct.detail: Pick a meal. Add protein. 20–30g minimum. No exceptions.

gentle.title: A calm 30 minutes before bed
gentle.detail: Dim the lights, set the phone aside. Let the day soften before sleep.

coach.title: 30-minute wind-down before bed
coach.detail: Lower the lights, drop the screens. Sleep onset gets easier with the runway.

firm_direct.title: 30 minutes. Lights low. No screens.
firm_direct.detail: Half an hour before bed: no phone, no laptop. Let sleep arrive.

gentle.title: Same bedtime, give or take
gentle.detail: Aim for tonight's bedtime within half an hour of usual. Routine compounds.

coach.title: Bedtime within ±30 min of usual
coach.detail: Hit your normal bedtime within a half-hour window tonight. Consistency is the win.

firm_direct.title: Bed at your usual time. ±30 min.
firm_direct.detail: Within thirty minutes of your normal bedtime. No drift.
